name: XL-Sum
description: XL-Sum is a large-scale multilingual abstractive summarization dataset with 1 million professionally annotated article-summary pairs from BBC, covering 44 languages from low to high resource. It supports research on multilingual and low-resource summarization.
typical_sota_score: ROUGE-L roughly 30–40 depending on language and model
reputation: A widely used multilingual summarization benchmark that has become a standard reference for low-resource and cross-lingual summarization research.
notes: Largest abstractive summarization dataset by samples and language coverage from a single source.
